propositions: The moved absence/tombstone cluster in binding_lifecycle.py (clear_absent, note_absent, note_absent_or_rekey) lacks integration-tier mutation oracle coverage; its no-churn/change-gating contract is pinned only at unit tier

An out-of-window-but-alive key cannot reach clear_absent on a healthy in-window pass because both call sites gate on out-of-window-but-alive keys while the idempotency fixture seeds every key in-window
The bound-but-absent direct GET runs through run_differs._load_reconcile_backend with a REAL backend whose transport 404s for synthetic keys instead of using the harness fake

test_reconcile_idempotency.py must be extended with harness support for out_of_window and deleted key sets, fake transport 404s, and pre-registered reconcile_run_differs to wire the diff-phase backend to the fake

Two new integration tests must verify: (1) an out-of-window-but-alive key reaches clear_absent with no mutations, no writes, and an untouched updated_at; (2) a 404->alive roundtrip correctly stamps absence and then clears the counter
Unconditional updated_at stamping in clear_absent must flip the updated_at value to a frozen sentinel, serving as the RED-driver oracle to validate the absence cluster's change-gate contract
